entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Kalim Rahim Shah

Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra
Mr.J.I.Shaikh, Advocate for the Applicant.
Mr.S.B.Narwade, App for the Respondent/State.

( Coram : Advait M. Sethna, J. )
 Date : 01 August 2025
P. C. :
1.

Heard the learned Advocate for the Applicant who appears
through video conferencing and the learned App.
2. Issue Notice to the Respondent.

Mr. Narwade, learned App
waives service of Notice on behalf of the Respondent/State.

3. The Applicant has approached this Court u/s 482 of the
Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 ("Bnss") as he apprehends
arrest.
3.  The proceedings relate to Crime No.0059/2025.
The FIR is lodged on 10 February 2025 at 17.00 Hours with the Rahata Police Station, Dist.Ahilyanagar.

The offences are registered u/s 26(2), 26(2)
khs/Aug.2025/1262  -2- (a), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and under Sections 123, 223, 274 and 275 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita,
Kalim Rahim Shah vs The State Of Maharashtra on 1 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182944810/
1 2023.

entities.text: Kalim Rahim Shah vs The State Of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The occurrence of the offence is shown on 10 February 2025.
There are three different crimes are registered against the accused person, who is the Applicant before the Court.

In this crime, Informant is one Balasaheb Ashok Gunjal, Police Constable B.No.176.
4.
From a perusal of the FIR, it appears that the issue here is regarding supplier of the contraband (gutka).
The parties would submit that the issue with regard to such contraband ( gutka) is a subject matter of pending proceedings in ABA No.857/2025 alongwith other connected applications.
The Applicant in the said proceedings have been protected.

5. Considering the above, this Applicant also deserves some protection by passing the following order :-
 ORDER (i) Until the adjourned date of hearing, in the event of arrest of the Applicant in connection with CR No.0059 of 2025 registered with Rahata Police Station, District :
Ahilyanagar for the offences punishable under Sections 26(2), 26(2)(a), 27(3)(d),
27(3)(e) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and under Sections 123, 223,
274 and 275 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, the Applicant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing PR bond in the sum of Rs.20,000 (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) with one or more sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The Applicant shall cooperate with the investigation and shall attend the concerned police station on every Tuesday at 11:30 a.m., until further orders.
(iii) The Applicant shall furnish details of residential address and other contact details such as mobile number etc. to the concerned police station.
If there is any change in the contact details, the same shall be immediately intimated to the concerned police station.
(iv) The Applicant shall not leave the jurisdiction of the Court without prior permission/order of the Court, until further orders.

(v) The Applicant shall not influence the witness/es and/or tamper evidence in any manner whatsoever.
Kalim Rahim Shah vs The State Of Maharashtra on 1 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182944810/
2 6.
